title: heavytails: A Pure-Python Library for Heavy-Tailed Probability Distributions
description: heavytails is a pure-Python library implementing heavy-tailed probability distributions, built from first principles without third-party dependencies. The library provides comprehensive support for continuous and discrete heavy-tailed distributions, tail index estimation methods, and diagnostic utilities for extreme value analysis, risk management, and financial modeling.
